title: Overpower
summary: OVERPOW'ER, verb transitive 1. To affect with a power or force that cannot be borne; as, the light overpowers the eyes. 2. To vanquish by force; to subdue; to reduce to silence in action or submission

inlines.v: OVERPOW'ER, verb transitive 1. To affect with a power or force that cannot be borne; as, the light overpowers the eyes. 2. To vanquish by force; to subdue; to reduce to silence in action or submission; to defeat.
